title: Viavo for press
lead: Viavo is a tap-to-talk AI voice assistant for drivers on iPhone and CarPlay. Press one button on the car screen, say what you need in your own words, and Viavo does it and answers out loud, with a native voice, in 31 languages.
why: Siri on CarPlay still doesn’t speak Polish, Czech, Slovak, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian or Ukrainian, and the new Siri AI isn’t available on iPhone in the EU. The chatbot apps that came to CarPlay mostly talk: OpenAI says ChatGPT in CarPlay can’t control other apps, and in ZDNET’s test ChatGPT and Perplexity couldn’t place a call, send a message or play music. Viavo speaks all of these languages and twenty more, understands everyday speech rather than fixed commands, and does the task.
Viavo is made by a small team in Serbia.
says: Take me home, with a stop for gas
The route opens in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.
A good restaurant on the way, in about an hour
Places with ratings, opening hours and reviews.
The call starts right from the car screen (iOS 27).

New WhatsApp and SMS messages read aloud, and a reply by voice (iOS 27). Telegram and Slack: the gist of a chat, a message read out, a dictated reply; Telegram voice messages in the sender’s own voice.
Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, Amazon Music or Deezer; live radio by name.
Remind me to call the bank when I get to the office
saysNote: And any question, with a web search for fresh facts.
facts: iPhone (iOS 17 or later; WhatsApp calls and message replies need iOS 27) and CarPlay
31, a native female or male voice in each
Polish, Czech, Slovak, Romanian, Greek, Hungarian, Croatian, Serbian, Ukrainian
Free to try: a free week of Viavo Plus (monthly or yearly subscription)
